title: Setting Up Your Monster Lab Station
summary: Install the Arduino IDE, connect your board via USB, and verify serial communication link.

steps.title: The Arduino IDE Workbench
steps.markdownContent: To give commands to your Monster, you write code in the **Arduino IDE** (Integrated Development Environment) on your computer.

steps.title: USB Cable Connection
steps.markdownContent: Plug the blue USB cable into your Arduino and your computer. Watch for the green `ON` LED illuminating on the board.

steps.title: Select Board and Port
steps.markdownContent: Go to **Tools > Board > Arduino Uno**, then select the active COM / Serial port for your device.

steps.title: Connection Checkpoint
steps.markdownContent: Which menu in the IDE lets you choose your Arduino board model?
